* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Use 1 Force to deploy to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an Undercover spy. If present with a smuggler of ability < 3 or [Permanent Weapon] Han, this weapon and that character are lost ("all cards" situation).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Han Seeker (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han Seeker (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) added “[Permanent Weapon] Han or”, changed “3 or [Permanent Weapon] Han,” to “3,” and changed “lost ("all cards"” to “lost ('all cards'”. PC-E1 text: “Use 1 Force to deploy to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an Undercover spy. If present with [Permanent Weapon] Han or a smuggler of ability < 3, this weapon and that character are lost ('all cards' situation).”<ref name="cl-1210_84-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
